name: bilderlabs-dashboard
description: Outreach CRM for Bilder Labs on Cloudflare Workers + D1: leads, follow-up schedule, email sequences and results.

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/seed-sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute bilder-leads --remote --file=.wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed-sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute bilder-leads --local --file=.wrangler/seed.sql
scripts.user:list: wrangler d1 execute bilder-leads --remote --command "SELECT id, username, name, created_at FROM users"
